verdict.rationale: Brex publishes a per-API reference on developer.brex.com (Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Payments, Transactions, Team, Webhooks, and others, with OpenAPI-derived pages such as /openapi/webhooks_api.md). It also has a quickstart and a first-party Postman guide for testing API calls through a UI without writing code, which serves as its documented route to runnable examples. However, nothing shows that the reference itself is interactive (e.g., in-page 'try it' consoles), and the standard OpenAPI spec paths returned 404. Missing for 10: an evidenced in-browser interactive reference with runnable requests, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the runnable-examples experience.
